Surrender.Name: Surrender
Surrender.Info: Surrender to the guards nearby: hands up, and the guard arrests you once he comes. Moving away or readying a weapon before he arrives is a fake surrender.

EscortToggle.Name: Escort: Walk on My Own / Be Led
EscortToggle.Info: While being escorted: switch between walking on your own beside the guard and being led by him. Led, he takes you the rest of the way until you press it again; walking on your own resumes once you're close to him.
